claims.statement: The coding-agent middleware chain is installed outer-to-inner with ConversationOffloadingMiddleware, preparation, conditional incident/workspace-skill/dynamic-tool layers, tool sanitation and validation, limits and policy guards, proxy and queue hooks, completion/usage hooks, optional model selection and fallback, plan mode, provider message guards, ModelErrorMiddleware, and innermost ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware.

ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware is installed innermost so its deadline covers the provider call itself, and a resulting ModelCallTimeoutError is recorded and re-raised by ModelErrorMiddleware before escalating outward to optional ModelFallbackMiddleware, which treats TimeoutError as transient.

The reviewer graph installs a leaner chain with preparation, sanitation, call limit, tool-error handling, proxy refresh, queue handling, wrap-up, message sanitizers, RepairOrphanedToolCallsMiddleware, stable ordering, ModelErrorMiddleware, ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware, and settle_review_check_on_exit; it has no fallback, plan-mode, PR/workflow guard, model selection, usage, or coding-tool policy layers.

check_message_queue_before_model is a before-model hook that reads the LangGraph store namespace (queue, thread_id), deletes pending_messages before building updates to prevent double-processing, and injects queued messages in FIFO order.

ModelFallbackMiddleware wraps the coding-agent model call in a retry loop that alternates primary and fallback models on transient errors, using a jittered backoff schedule and retrying eligible provider statuses, connection/timeout errors, retryable LangChain model errors, and ModelCallTimeoutError.

When every ModelFallbackMiddleware attempt fails it returns a terminal outage AIMessage by default instead of raising, while recognized Anthropic and OpenAI model-not-available errors short-circuit into user-facing AIMessage responses; surface_outage_message=False re-raises the final error.

PlanModeMiddleware strips configured external-mutation tools from each coding-agent model request while plan mode is active, resets plan_mode in before_agent to the value resolved for the current run, and honors a mid-run enter_plan_mode because the tool list is recomputed each call.

ToolErrorMiddleware converts ordinary unhandled tool exceptions into status=error ToolMessages, but treats an unreachable sandbox as terminal: it notifies the user and re-raises the error to end the run.

ToolErrorMiddleware converts SDK-marked transient sandbox connection errors into sandbox_transient ToolMessages because the command never started, while SandboxConnectionError except SandboxServerReloadError and sandbox ResourceNotFoundError are unreachable and are notified then re-raised.

The coding agent installs ToolRetryMiddleware scoped to task with task_retry_on retrying 5xx/429-class statuses and transient exception names including a subagent ModelCallTimeoutError; task_on_failure returns a structured failed payload for prompt/context errors and re-raises otherwise.

Reviewer sandbox setup permits replacement because its checkout is re-derived, whereas default coding-agent sandbox setup does not; a failed replacement remains a typed SandboxUnreachableError and reviewer preparation notifies it as a replacement attempt.

BasePrepareRunMiddleware fingerprints the latest message, middleware class, and preparation configuration; its checkpointed run_prepared_for latch skips setup for a resumed matching invocation, while preparation can execute again after a pre-checkpoint failure and must be idempotent.

ModelErrorMiddleware logs and classifies model-call exceptions, records the error type and classification code in thread metadata when context is available, and re-raises the original exception unchanged.

RecordRunUsageMiddleware tags model responses with invocation and route metadata, finalizes configured invocation usage after the agent, and finalizes it with error status before re-raising a model-call exception.

settle_review_check_on_exit closes an unpublished tracked reviewer check as neutral so an incomplete review is not presented as a PR code failure, but retries a stored pending real conclusion when publish_review completed and only its completion PATCH failed.

Coding and reviewer subagents compile as independent graphs rather than being wrapped by parent middleware; coding subagents include policy and model guards while reviewer subagents include OpenAI response sanitation, ModelErrorMiddleware, and ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware.
ModelSelectionMiddleware selects and persists a coding model route, emits it in automatic mode, overrides the request model, and uses the performance route during plan mode.

SanitizeToolInputsMiddleware coerces malformed integer values for read_file offset and limit, while ValidateImageReadsMiddleware converts a non-image payload labeled as an image into a text error result.

PullRequestCreationGuardMiddleware blocks execute and background_execute shell fallbacks that create pull requests, and WorkflowPushGuardMiddleware forwards workflow-changing pushes only after approval of the exact change fingerprint.

refresh_github_proxy_before_model best-effort refreshes a near-expiry sandbox GitHub proxy token before each model call, and TimeoutWrapupMiddleware appends a wrap-up instruction after its configured or default 45-minute run clock.
RepairOrphanedToolCallsMiddleware inserts synthetic error ToolMessages for persisted AI tool calls lacking a matching result, preventing provider rejection on a resumed reviewer thread.
